checks.title: Unattached managed disks

waf.why: An unattached disk is a component that costs without serving.

collector.violations: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/disks' | where isempty(managedBy) and tostring(properties.diskState) =~ 'Unattached' | project id, name, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, diskSizeGb=tolong(properties.diskSizeGB), diskState=tostring(properties.diskState)

checks.proves: The managed disk has no owner VM and its state is Unattached.
checks.doesNotProve: How much it costs, or whether someone keeps it on purpose (for example a snapshot source).

checks.title: Public IP addresses not associated

waf.why: An unassociated address is a component that costs without serving.

collector.violations: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.network/publicipaddresses' | where isnull(properties.ipConfiguration) | project id, name, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, allocation=tostring(properties.publicIPAllocationMethod)

checks.proves: The public IP address has no IP configuration.
checks.doesNotProve: How much it costs, or whether a DNS record points at it.

checks.title: Advisor cost recommendations

waf.why: Advisor cost recommendations point at components to optimize.

collector.evaluated: advisorresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations' | where tostring(properties.category) =~ 'Cost' | summarize n=count()
collector.violations: advisorresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations' | where tostring(properties.category) =~ 'Cost' | project id, subscriptionId, impact=tostring(properties.impact), problem=tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem)

checks.proves: Azure Advisor lists a recommendation in the Cost category for the resource.
checks.doesNotProve: Savings in money (no Cost Management data in v1), or that the recommendation is right for the workload.

checks.title: Resources without a cost center tag

waf.why: Tags are one input of a cost allocation model; this is a supporting measure, not a mapping to CO:04.
They feed the cost data that is reviewed.

collector.violations: resources | where isempty(tostring(tags['costcenter'])) | project id, name, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, owner=tostring(tags['owner'])

checks.proves: The resource has no non-empty tag named costcenter.
checks.doesNotProve: That cost is allocated correctly, or that the tag value is right. The owner tag is hashed, never shown.

checks.title: Reservations and savings plans

waf.why: Committed-use rates are a way to get better prices.

checks.noApi: Reservations are a billing API (Microsoft.Capacity, Cost Management) that v1 does not call.
checks.proves: Nothing: v1 has no source for it.
checks.doesNotProve: Everything; reservations and savings plans are not in Resource Graph and Cost Management is out of scope in v1.

checks.title: Budgets and spending alerts

waf.why: Budgets and alerts are spending guardrails.

text.en: Are budgets with alerts defined for each subscription or workload, and who receives the alerts?
text.pt-BR: Existem orçamentos com alertas definidos para cada assinatura ou carga de trabalho, e quem recebe os alertas?

checks.proves: The answer of the person who knows the practice.
checks.doesNotProve: The amounts or the alert routing; Cost Management is not read in v1.
